sources.title: Qwen3-14B-FP8 Open-source AI Model - Supports long contexts and is ...
sources.snippet: This is the version after NVIDIA quantizes Alibaba's Qwen3-14B model to FP8. It adopts an optimized Transformer architecture, supports a context length of 131K, and is suitable for various AI application scenarios.
